	    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const DEFAULT_COUNTER_DURATION = 1500;
        const easeOut = t => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

        function animateCounter(el) {
            if (el.dataset.played === '1') return;
            el.dataset.played = '1';

            const startVal = parseFloat(el.dataset.start) || 0;
            const endVal = parseFloat(el.dataset.end) || 0;
            const unit = el.dataset.unit || '';
            const startUnit = el.dataset.startUnit || '';
            const duration = parseInt(el.dataset.duration || DEFAULT_COUNTER_DURATION, 10);

            const t0 = performance.now();
            function frame(now) {
                const p = Math.min((now - t0) / duration, 1);
                const eased = easeOut(p);
                const curr = Math.floor(startVal + (endVal - startVal) * eased);
                el.textContent = startUnit + curr + unit;
                if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
            }
            requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }

        function runCountersIn(root) {
            if (!root) return;
            root.querySelectorAll('.counter').forEach(animateCounter);
        }

        function isInViewport(el, threshold = 0.8) {
            const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            const visibleTop = Math.max(rect.top, 0);
            const visibleBottom = Math.min(rect.bottom, window.innerHeight);
            const visibleHeight = Math.max(0, visibleBottom - visibleTop);
            return visibleHeight >= rect.height * threshold;
        }

        function runCountersIn(root) {
            if (!root) return;

            const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        animateCounter(entry.target);
                        counterObserver.unobserve(entry.target); // Ensure it only runs once
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 }); // Adjust threshold as needed

            root.querySelectorAll('.counter').forEach(el => counterObserver.observe(el));
        }

        function tryRunCountersForSlide(slide) {
            if (!slide) return;
            runCountersIn(slide);
        }

        const CONTENT_MS = 500;
        const BG_MS = 1000;
        const AUTO_MS = 10000;
        const THRESHOLD = 60;
        const ANGLE_GUARD = 0.577;
        const MIN_VELOCITY = 0.3;
        const isMobile = () => window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)').matches;

        function transitionElement(el, opacity, transform, duration) {
            if (!el) return;
            el.style.transitionDuration = `${duration}ms`;
            el.style.opacity = opacity;
            el.style.transform = transform;
        }

        function getCoords(e) {
            if (e.touches && e.touches.length) return e.touches[0];
            if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches.length) return e.changedTouches[0];
            return e;
        }

        // --- IMPROVED HEIGHT LOGIC ---
        function setHeight(hero) {
            const children = hero.querySelectorAll('.customer-testimonial-component__slide');
            let maxHeight = 0;

            // Temporarily show slides to measure
            children.forEach(el => {
                const originalDisplay = el.style.display;
                el.style.display = 'block';
                el.style.height = ''; // Reset to measure natural content height
                maxHeight = Math.max(maxHeight, el.offsetHeight);
                el.style.display = originalDisplay;
            });

            children.forEach(el => {
                el.style.height = isMobile() ? maxHeight + 'px' : '';
            });
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.customer-testimonial-component-containers').forEach(container => {
            const hero = container.querySelector('.customer-testimonial-component');
            if (!hero) return;

            // 1. Initial height set
            setHeight(hero);

            // 2. Re-calculate when images load
            hero.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(img => {
                if (img.src !== '') return;
                img.addEventListener('load', () => setHeight(hero));
                img.addEventListener('error', () => setHeight(hero));
            });

            // 3. Re-calculate on resize (with debounce)
            let resizeTimer;
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
                resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    setHeight(hero);
                    updateMargins(); // Also update margins on resize
                }, 150);
            }, { passive: true });

            // --- MARGIN LOGIC ---
            function updateMargins() {
                const vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
                const heroWidth = hero.getBoundingClientRect().width;
                const available = Math.max(0, vw - heroWidth);

                if (available === 0) {
                    container.style.marginLeft = '0';
                    container.style.marginRight = '0';
                    return;
                }

                const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
                const winH = window.innerHeight;
                const visibleTop = Math.max(0, Math.min(rect.height, winH - rect.top));
                const visibleBottom = Math.max(0, Math.min(rect.height, rect.bottom));
                const visibleHeight = Math.min(visibleTop, visibleBottom);
                const visibilityRatio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, visibleHeight / rect.height));

                const baseToEdge = available / 2;
                const extraCap = isMobile() ? 16 : 24;
                const totalPerSide = baseToEdge + extraCap;
                const marginOffset = totalPerSide * visibilityRatio;

                const px = Math.round(marginOffset);
                container.style.marginLeft = `${-px}px`;
                container.style.marginRight = `${-px}px`;
            }

            window.addEventListener('scroll', updateMargins, { passive: true });
            window.addEventListener('orientationchange', () => setTimeout(updateMargins, 100), { passive: true });

            // --- DATA LAYER / TRACKING ---
            container.querySelectorAll('.splunk-btn').forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const headline = el.closest('.customer-testimonial-component__col')?.querySelector('.customer-testimonial-component__headline')?.textContent || 'Unknown';
                    const eventLabel = (el.classList.contains('sp-btn-solid') ? 'All stories-' : 'Read the story-') + headline;

                    window.dataLayer?.push({
                        event: 'carousel_click',
                        link_text: eventLabel,
                        link_domain: `${window.location.hostname}/${document.body.lang}`,
                        link_url: el.href,
                        link_position: 'CarouselContainer'
                    });
                });
            });

            // --- CAROUSEL CORE LOGIC ---
            const slides = Array.from(hero.querySelectorAll('.customer-testimonial-component__slide'));
            const logos = Array.from(hero.querySelectorAll('.logos__item'));
            if (!slides.length) return;

            let current = slides.findIndex(s => s.classList.contains('active'));
            if (current === -1) {
                current = 0;
                slides[0].classList.add('active');
            }

            tryRunCountersForSlide(slides[current]);

            let autoReady = false;
            let lock = false;
            let autoTimer = null;

            function stopAuto() {
                clearTimeout(autoTimer);
                autoTimer = null;
            }

            function startAuto() {
                if (!autoReady) return;
                stopAuto();
                autoTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    showSlide((current + 1) % slides.length);
                }, AUTO_MS);
            }

            function updateLogos() {
                logos.forEach(l => l.removeAttribute('aria-current'));
                const m = logos.find(l => parseInt(l.dataset.slide, 10) === current);
                if (m) m.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
            }

            (function setupAutoGate() {
                const firstSlide = slides[0];
                const unlock = () => {
                    if (autoReady) return;
                    autoReady = true;
                    startAuto();
                };
                if (isInViewport(firstSlide, 0.8)) {
                    unlock();
                } else if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
                    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                        if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
                            io.disconnect();
                            unlock();
                        }
                    }, { threshold: 0.8 });
                    io.observe(firstSlide);
                }
            })();

            function showSlide(target) {
                if (lock || target === current || target < 0 || target >= slides.length) return;
                lock = true;
                stopAuto();

                const outgoing = slides[current];
                const incoming = slides[target];
                const direction = target > current ? 'next' : 'prev';

                const inContent = incoming.querySelector('.customer-testimonial-component__content');
                const outBg = outgoing.querySelector('.customer-testimonial-component__bgImg');
                const inBg = incoming.querySelector('.customer-testimonial-component__bgImg');

                current = target;
                updateLogos();
                setTimeout(() => tryRunCountersForSlide(incoming), 100);

                if (isMobile()) {
                    incoming.classList.add('active');
                    transitionElement(inContent, '0', direction === 'next' ? 'translateX(32px)' : 'translateX(-32px)', CONTENT_MS);
                    outgoing.classList.remove('active');
                    outgoing.classList.add('is-outgoing');
                    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                        outgoing.style.opacity = '0';
                        transitionElement(inContent, '1', 'translateX(0)', CONTENT_MS);
                    });
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        outgoing.classList.remove('is-outgoing');
                        outgoing.style.opacity = '';
                        [inContent].forEach(el => { if(el) el.style = ''; });
                        lock = false;
                        startAuto();
                    }, CONTENT_MS);
                    return;
                }

                // Desktop Transition
                incoming.classList.add('is-incoming');
                incoming.style.opacity = '0';
                transitionElement(inContent, '0', direction === 'next' ? 'translateX(32px)' : 'translateX(-32px)', CONTENT_MS);
                transitionElement(inBg, '0.001', direction === 'next' ? 'translateX(32px)' : 'translateX(-32px)', BG_MS);

                incoming.offsetHeight; // Force reflow
                incoming.style.opacity = '1';

                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    transitionElement(inBg, '1', 'translateX(0)', BG_MS);
                    transitionElement(inContent, '1', 'translateX(0)', CONTENT_MS);
                    outgoing.style.opacity = '0';
                });

                setTimeout(() => {
                    outgoing.classList.remove('active');
                    outgoing.style.opacity = '';
                    incoming.classList.remove('is-incoming');
                    incoming.classList.add('active');
                    [inContent, inBg, outBg].forEach(el => { if(el) { el.style.opacity = el.style.transform = el.style.transitionDuration = ''; } });
                    lock = false;
                    startAuto();
                }, BG_MS);
            }

            logos.forEach(logo => {
                logo.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    window.dataLayer?.push({
                        carousel_name: 'Customer Testimonial Carousel',
                        event: 'carousel_click',
                        event_action: 'slick dots',
                        link_text: logo.getAttribute('aria-label')
                    });
                    showSlide(parseInt(logo.dataset.slide, 10));
                });
            });

            // Swipe Handling
            let startX = 0, startY = 0, dragging = false;
            const onStart = (e) => {
                const p = getCoords(e);
                startX = p.clientX; startY = p.clientY;
                dragging = true; stopAuto();
            };
            const onMove = (e) => {
                if (!dragging) return;
                const p = getCoords(e);
                if (Math.abs(p.clientX - startX) >= Math.abs(p.clientY - startY) * ANGLE_GUARD && e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
            };
            const onEnd = (e) => {
                if (!dragging) return;
                dragging = false;
                const p = getCoords(e);
                const dx = p.clientX - startX;
                if (Math.abs(dx) >= THRESHOLD) {
                    showSlide(dx < 0 ? (current + 1) % slides.length : (current - 1 + slides.length) % slides.length);
                } else {
                    startAuto();
                }
            };

            hero.addEventListener('touchstart', onStart, { passive: true });
            hero.addEventListener('touchmove', onMove, { passive: false });
            hero.addEventListener('touchend', onEnd, { passive: true });

            updateLogos();
            startAuto();
            updateMargins();
        });
    });
</script>

//patch to fix the mobile shifting after interacting with the nav links.
// callback function for the initial setup
const setupCarousel = (entries, observer) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {      
      // 1. Setup Navigation DOM
      document.querySelectorAll('.splunkADACarousel-slideButtonContainer').forEach(el => el.setAttribute('href','javascript:void(0)'));
      const navClone = document.querySelector('.splunkADACarousel-navigation').cloneNode(true);
      document.querySelector('.splunkADACarousel-navigation').remove();
      document.querySelector('.splunkADACarousel-gallery').after(navClone);

      // 2. Setup Click Handlers
      document.querySelectorAll('.splunkADACarousel-slideButtonContainer').forEach(button => {
          button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
              e.preventDefault(); 
              document.querySelectorAll('.splunkADACarousel-slideButtonContainer').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
              button.classList.add('active'); // Use button instead of e.target to ensure we get the container

              const gallery = document.querySelector('.peer-review .splunkADACarousel-gallery');
              const slideIndex = parseInt(button.getAttribute('data-slide-reference'));
              const gap = 30; 
              const scrollPos = slideIndex * (gallery.offsetWidth + gap);
              
              gallery.scrollTo({ left: scrollPos, behavior: 'smooth' });
          });
      });

      // 3. NEW: Setup Swipe/Scroll Observer
      const gallery = document.querySelector('.peer-review .splunkADACarousel-gallery');
      const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.splunkADACarousel-slideElement');
      
      const swipeObserver = new IntersectionObserver((slideEntries) => {
        slideEntries.forEach(slideEntry => {
          if (slideEntry.isIntersecting) {
            const index = slideEntry.target.getAttribute('data-slide-index');
            document.querySelectorAll('.splunkADACarousel-slideButtonContainer').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.splunkADACarousel-slideButtonContainer')[index].classList.add('active');
          }
        });
      }, { root: gallery, threshold: 0.6 });

      slides.forEach(slide => swipeObserver.observe(slide));

      observer.unobserve(entry.target);
    }
  });
};

// Initialize the setup observer
if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
  const options = { root: null, rootMargin: '150px 0px 150px 0px', threshold: 0 };
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(setupCarousel, options);
  const target = document.querySelector('.splunkADACarousel-gallery');
  
  if (target) {
    observer.observe(target);
  }
}
</script>

    position: absolute;
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center;

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  #ai-driven-bg {

    background-position: center;
    transform: translateY(100px);

}

<script>
let aiBgContainer = document.createElement('div');
aiBgContainer.id = 'ai-driven-bg';
let aiBgContainerParent = document.querySelectorAll("#ai-driven-container + div .splunk-fixedWidth-container");
const detectVerticalScrollPixelsforEnder = window.scrollY;
const browserWidth = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth || document.body.clientWidth;

const loadingBG = () => {
  //lazy loading bottom half of the background images.
  if (browserWidth > 767) {
    document.querySelector('#btm-half-container + div > .splunk-container').style.background = "url(/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/homepage/fy26/v8-hp-bottom-2-background.svg)";
  } else {
    document.querySelector('#btm-half-container + div > .splunk-container').style.background = "url(/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/homepage/fy26/v7-hp-bg-bottom-m.svg)";
  }

  //lazy loading the background images for the ender.
  if (browserWidth > 767) {
    document.querySelector('#hp-ender-container + div > .splunk-container').style.backgroundImage = "url(/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/homepage/fy26/hp-ender-bg-center-r-d.avif)";
  } else {
    document.querySelector('#hp-ender-container + div > .splunk-container').style.backgroundImage  = "url(/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/homepage/fy26/hp-ender-bg-center-m.png)";
  }  
};

const lazyLoadBgImages = () => {
  const targets = aiBgContainerParent;

  const observerOptions = {
    root: null,              // viewport
    rootMargin: "500px 0px 0px 0px", // preload slightly before visible
    threshold: 0
  };

  const loadComponent = (element) => {
    // Replace this with your actual lazy-load logic
    loadingBG();
  };

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, obs) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        loadComponent(entry.target);
        // obs.unobserve(entry.target); // load once
      }
    });
  }, observerOptions);

  targets.forEach(target => observer.observe(target));
}

lazyLoadBgImages();


if (detectVerticalScrollPixelsforEnder > 10) { 
  setTimeout(()=>{
    loadingBG();
  }, 500);
}

window.addEventListener('resize', function(event) {
  setTimeout(() => {
    loadingBG();      
  },100)
});
</script>
